read.thesis: HSBC 1Q26 RoTE ex-notables 18.7% (up 0.3pt y/y) and banking NII guide raised to ~$46bn, but ECL guide lifted to ~45bps and CET1 down to 14.0%; a bank, so supply-side capital-cycle signals are limited.

triggers.label: Banking NII guide raised to ~$46bn
triggers.quote: We now expect banking NII of around $46bn in 2026, reflecting an improved interest rate outlook

triggers.label: ECL guide raised 40bps → 45bps
triggers.quote: We now expect an ECL charge as a percentage of average gross loans to be around 45bps

triggers.label: Downside stress could cut RoTE below 17%
triggers.quote: could bring RoTE excluding notable items below our 17% or better target in 2026
triggers.highlight: below our 17% or better target in 2026

triggers.label: Wealth NNM $39bn vs $23bn 1Q25
triggers.quote: Within this we have attracted net new money (‘NNM’) in 1Q26 of $ 39bn

guidance.quote: including a RoTE of 17% or better for 2026, 2027 and 2028, excluding notable items.
We now expect banking NII of around $46bn in 2026

guidance.metric: ECL as % of average gross loans 2026
guidance.quote: We now expect an ECL charge as a percentage of average gross loans to be around 45bps
We continue to target growth in target basis operating expenses of approximately 1% compared with 2025.
We intend to continue to manage the CET1 capital ratio within our medium-term target range of 14%–14.5%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: We had previously provided banking NII guidance of at least $45bn for 2026.

prior_guidance_check.metric: ECL as % of average gross loans 2026
prior_guidance_check.quote: Our previous ECL guidance for 2026 was around 40bps of average gross loans
We continue to target growth in target basis operating expenses of approximately 1% compared with 2025.

red_flags.label: Fraud-related $0.4bn securitisation charge in CIB
red_flags.quote: a $0.4bn fraud-related, secondary, securitisation exposure with a financial sponsor in the UK in our Corporate and Institutional Banking

red_flags.label: CET1 down 0.9pt to 14.0%; buy-backs paused
red_flags.quote: A decision to recommence buy-backs will be subject to our normal buy-back considerations
